messages:
Dan P.: Quick heads-up — field lab next Wed (4/12) with AcmeInfra + CloudWave. In-person cohost, livestream, 3 partner demo stations. Need final run-of-show + AV checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Maya R.: On it. Draft run-of-show will be in drive in 30m, will ping speakers for minute allocations.
Sophia L.: Venue walk Monday 10:00am with onsite AV. Can someone itemize hard requirements per demo so I can confirm drops/power?
Kevin T.: Demo A (low-latency chat): 1x RTX A6000, wired ethernet (1Gb), HDMI out to stage screen. Demo B (batch embeddings): needs local SSD and reliable power (surge protector), USB-C for dev laptop. Demo C (private deploy): isolated VLAN + HSM test — needs outbound 443 only to our control plane and SSH to vendor jumpbox.
Arjun S.: I'm drafting firewall rule set for Demo C. Will require partner to allow our jumpbox IPs and a short window for SSH during setup.
Zoe H.: Swag inventory: 200 t-shirts (mixed sizes), 150 sticker packs, 50 demo quickstart cards, 30 sticker sheets for partners. Shipping ETA Tue 09:30am. Do we station swag table or have hosts hand out?
Maya R.: Recommend a dedicated swag table (easier to manage inventory and collect emails). Also planning a raffle at the end of session for 3 swag bundles.
Dan P.: Livestream path: venue suggests Vimeo Live via their hardware encoder. Need a network test and clear ownership of the stream key and failover plan.
Kevin T.: I'll own network & encoder tests. Requesting a static IP for the encoder during the event window to avoid NAT flakiness with stream key. Also will bring a secondary 4G encoder as hot standby.
Sophia L.: I'll ask venue IT for static IP allocation and a secondary internet feed for redundancy. Adding onsite contact and tech escalation numbers to the doc.
Arjun S.: Fallback plan for OOM on local GPUs: fallback to quantized variant hosted on Redwood Dedicated with reduced QPS. Will create an attendee slide explaining fallback and a 30s emcee script.
Maya R.: Add fallback slide + emcee sticky note. Script: quick note on graceful degradation and point to partner booths for deeper dive.
Zoe H.: Volunteer schedule: need 2 people at swag table 30 mins before doors. Volunteers confirmed: @Maya R., @Zoe H. Also need one runner to shuttle demo kits — Kevin?
Kevin T.: I can be runner during setup and handle mic/encoder checks. Mic check scheduled 3:00pm for speakers: Arjun, Kevin, AcmeInfra rep. Please be prompt.
Sophia L.: AV checklist for venue walk — paste to venue:
```
- Stage mics x2 (lav + handheld)
- HDMI loopthrough tested at 4k/30hz
- Encoder with static IP + secondary internet feed
- Power strips (x4) per demo table + surge protectors
- Ethernet drop to each demo table (1Gb)
- Spare laptop with HDMI and USB-C adapters
- Onsite tech contact + cell number
```
Dan P.: Add backup contacts to doc: venue tech, our on-call, partner tech lead. Put phone numbers and emails.
Arjun S.: Added partner tech lead: Maria (AcmeInfra) and our on-call: kevin.t@example.com, +1-415-555-0123. Also attached firewall rule snippet in the doc.
Maya R.: Outreach: final attendee email going out tomorrow AM with schedule, speakers, and livestream link. Draft ready — will post in the doc for review.
Zoe H.: Shipping note: I'll confirm courier pickup window and affix a sticker manifest on each case for quick intake. Also ordering a small lockbox for demo SSDs.
Dan P.: Ops owners: Kevin — network & encoder; Sophia — venue IT/static IP & AV; Arjun — firewall rules + fallback slide; Maya & Zoe — swag + run-of-show finalization. Everyone ok?
Kevin T.: OK.
Sophia L.: OK.
Arjun S.: OK.
Maya R.: OK.
Zoe H.: OK.
Dan P.: Perfect. We'll meet at Mon 10:00am at venue for the walk. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
